title: RF-195 final-review follow-ups: Back reshow clears page errors, one run-payload read on a failed /live restore, one Apple error read
acceptance: Back/Forward that shows the still-loaded class again (the RF-195 reshow path in the Dashboard path reader) clears the same page-level error a click-path open clears, so a message from Music or Account does not stay over the class.
A refreshed /classes/<id>/live whose detail read could not get the run payload shows that read’s error instead of sending a second run-payload request for it.

App reads a failed Apple sign-in code once per page load (for example a ref captured on the first sign-in render), so showing it no longer depends on Login having captured it before the code is stripped.
